from openpyxl.styles import PatternFill

# style if present; otherwise use standard Excel green fill.
min_col, min_row, max_col, max_row = range_boundaries(answer_range)

# Look for an existing green-ish fill in the workbook to reuse if present.
def is_greenish(cell):
    color = cell.fill.fgColor
    if cell.fill.fill_type is None:
        return False
    rgb = color.rgb if color.type == "rgb" else None

            g = int(rgb[4:6], 16)
            b = int(rgb[6:8], 16)
